datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators conducted regular (typically monthly) field surveys across Afghanistan to classify food insecurity conditions using the IPC framework. Geographic data were compiled into monthly medium-term projection datasets for 2020, with classifications reflecting food security status across administrative areas.

sources.name: FEWS NET
sources.description: Integrated Food Security Phase Classification (IPC) spatial data collected through regular enumerator surveys providing geographic classifications of acute food insecurity across Afghanistan
